snippet.title: Compress(space) demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

Compress(space) by @bdeshiinteractive4293  has an updated demo out!

Compress(space) in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/compress-space/
Compress(space) on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664840/Compressspace/

https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
